settings.title: Small editions, never collections
settings.body: Forty to sixty pieces per style. Not one more. When they are gone, they are gone.

settings.title: Natural fibres, named mills
settings.body: Linen from Como (since 1894), wool from the Scottish Borders, cotton from Porto. We visit before we commission.

settings.title: Cut to the body, not the warehouse
settings.body: Every pattern is hand-adjusted. We do not produce to stock. No surplus. No landfill.

settings.title: Mended free, forever
settings.body: Any VELA garment, repaired at cost for as long as we exist. No exceptions. No expiry date.

settings.title: One price, all year
settings.body: We do not hold sales or markdowns. Our prices are set to be final prices, for customers who plan ahead.

settings.title: Quiet, on purpose
settings.body: No paid advertising. No collaborations for visibility. A bi-weekly letter, and the clothes.
